name: sagaflow
description: Zero-budget, self-hostable, multi-tenant distributed Workflow & Saga Orchestration Engine with pluggable storage

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sagaflow/shared && npm run build -w @sagaflow/engine && npm run build -w @sagaflow/sdk && npm run build -w @sagaflow/api && npm run build -w @sagaflow/web
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @sagaflow/shared && npm run build -w @sagaflow/engine && npm run build -w @sagaflow/sdk && npm run build -w @sagaflow/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sagaflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sagaflow/engine && npm run typecheck -w @sagaflow/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @sagaflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @sagaflow/web
